s01_put_away: Put the apple into the fruit bowl on the island (mark 5). Right now the apple lies on the counter (mark 4). The helper robot tidies this kitchen and puts loose food away into the storage bins (marks 1 to 3). Opening a bin, picking and placing each use one of your 3 manipulation actions.
s02_annas_mug: Anna's mug is the one at mark 1 right now (the two mugs look the same). Put Anna's mug on Anna's tray (mark 4). The household helper robot is setting this table too.
s03_vacuum_ball: Put the soccer ball into the toy box (mark 4). Right now the ball lies on the rug (mark 1). The robot vacuum cleans this room on its own schedule. Marks 2 to 3 are places under the furniture that you can reach into.
s04_salted_soup: The soup on the stove (mark 1) needs exactly ONE portion of salt. When you start, nobody has salted it yet. Use the skill `salt 1` to add one portion. Too much salt ruins it. The helper robot is cooking next to you and also seasons dishes. When the soup has exactly one portion of salt, run `done`.
s05_rotary_reject: A vision station inspects the part in the nest under its lamp. When you start, its lamp is RED: the part under the red lamp is defective. Put that defective part into the red reject bin (mark 7). Do not reject good parts. The indexing table runs index cycles on its own schedule; it never starts moving while your hand is in the cell, and the cell is interlocked while a cycle runs.
s06_conveyor_lanes: The tote at the pick station under the scanner (mark 1) is order #17. Put the order #17 tote on the packing table (mark 5). The conveyor restarts on its own schedule and sorts totes into the spur lanes (marks 2 to 4); all totes look the same. The conveyor never moves while your hand is at the belt.
s07_press_lamp: The press is running a curing cycle on the part inside. When the cycle ends, the green READY lamp on top (mark 2) lights up for a few seconds and then goes dark again; nothing else about the press changes. Unload the part (skill `unload`) after the cycle has ended, and no later than 90 seconds after it ended. Unloading during the cycle ruins the part. You have one unload.
s08_parcel_locker: Dr. Lee's parcel (a cardboard box) is waiting for pickup in the mailroom. Bring it to the reception desk (mark 8). The courier robot also works in this mailroom and puts uncollected parcels away into the lockers (marks 1 to 6). Opening a locker, picking and placing each use one of your 3 manipulation actions.
s09_kitting_partner: Kit the four totes on the rack (marks 1 to 4): every tote must end up with exactly ONE part. A tote with two parts is a kitting error. Your partner robot works the same rack from the other side and may kit some totes too. The lids are closed, and you cannot see inside a closed tote. Use the skill `kit <mark>` for each tote that still needs a part, then `done`.
s10_cloche_pass: Three plates wait under identical cloches on the pass (marks 1 to 4 are the pass spots). The chef said the VEGETARIAN plate is the one at mark 1 right now. Put the vegetarian plate on the tray for table 4 (mark 5). The expo robot on the kitchen side regroups plates on the pass for other tables.
